title: Bureau IT Leadership Directory Schema version 1.0
description: Schema definition for describing bureau IT leaders for an agency.

allOf.title: Leaders schema.
allOf.description: A directory of the bureau IT leaders for this agency
allOf.name: leaders

evaluationReviewingOfficialTitle.title: EvaluationReviewingOfficialTitle schema.
evaluationReviewingOfficialTitle.description: The title of the leader's evaluation reviwing official..
evaluationReviewingOfficialTitle.name: evaluationReviewingOfficialTitle

otherResponsibilities.title: OtherResponsibilities schema.
otherResponsibilities.description: Description of other responsibilities of this leader.
otherResponsibilities.name: otherResponsibilities

bureauCode.title: BureauCode schema.
bureauCode.description: 2 digit integer bureau code, per A-11 Appendix C: https://www.whitehouse.gov/sites/default/files/omb/assets/a11_current_year/app_c.pdf
bureauCode.name: bureauCode

employmentTypeOther.title: EmploymentTypeOther schema.
employmentTypeOther.description: When employtmentType Other was chosen, this field contains a description of the employment type.
employmentTypeOther.name: employmentTypeOther

employmentType.title: EmploymentType schema.
employmentType.description: Employment type.  One of GS, SES, SL, ST, or Other.
employmentType.name: employmentType

typeOfAppointment.title: TypeOfAppointment schema.
typeOfAppointment.description: The type of appointment for this leader.  Must be either career or political.
typeOfAppointment.name: typeOfAppointment

evaluationRatingOfficialTitle.title: EvaluationRatingOfficialTitle schema.
evaluationRatingOfficialTitle.description: The title of the leader's evaluation rating official.
evaluationRatingOfficialTitle.name: evaluationRatingOfficialTitle

keyBureauCIO.title: KeyBureauCIO schema.
keyBureauCIO.description: Set this field to Yes if this leader a key bureau CIO.
